subject: Security exhibit: scope, pen-test window & evidence rhythm for Starlight Health MSA
messages:
From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@starlighthealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@starlighthealth.com, procurement@starlighthealth.com
Date: 2026-08-12T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Security exhibit clarifications for MSA (SOC 2 / pen test)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for sending the draft MSA and order form. Our security and procurement teams reviewed the security exhibit and had a few open items before we can sign:

- We need confirmation of Redwood's SOC 2 scope and the most recent report (date).
- Pen test language: we prefer a scoped vendor-initiated pen test with 30-day notice and evidence of remediation cadence. The draft asks for broader "audit rights" than we can permit for PHI-handling systems.
- Evidence cadence: procurement asked how frequently we can expect answers to evidence requests (logs, architecture diagrams, PII handling descriptions). Our standard is a 10-business-day turnaround.

Can your security/legal team confirm what you can commit to in the security exhibit and whether a scoped pen test (targeting inference/control plane, excluding customer s3 buckets) would be acceptable?

Appreciate a short summary we can share with our DPO.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Li
Sr. Contracts Manager | Starlight Health

---
Attachment: Starlight_Security_Questions_08-11.xlsx (spreadsheet, 45KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@starlighthealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-13T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit clarifications for MSA (SOC 2 / pen test)

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear list. I pulled Marcus and Laura in to keep answers short and actionable. Below is a concise response you can share with your DPO and procurement:  

1) SOC 2: Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II report in scope for our production inference stack. The most recent report we can share under an NDA is "SOC2_Snapshot_2025.pdf" (attached). Our SOC covers access control, change management, and the inference service control plane — it does not extend to customer-managed storage.

2) Pen test / audit rights: We are open to a vendor-conducted pen test, scoped to Redwood-managed components (inference runtime, control plane, APIs). We cannot grant access to customer-managed or customer-configured storage. Proposed guardrails:
- 30-day scheduling notice (agree)
- Scoped pen test SOW with explicit excluded assets (agree)
- Non-production test window recommended for live systems where possible

3) Evidence cadence: Standard internal SLA is 10 business days for packaged SOC-related evidence (policies, diagrams). For live logs or forensic exports, we request up to 15 business days. If Starlight needs a guaranteed 10-day turnaround, we can commit to that for the SOC-packaged items and agree to triage any forensic requests on an expedited basis.

Next steps: Marcus will propose a pen test SOW and timing. Laura will provide a redline of the audit-rights paragraph in the security exhibit to align with the exclusions above. I attached a working draft of our security exhibit and a SOC snapshot.

Would a 2-week pen-test window in October work for your team?

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Exhibit_v1.pdf, SOC2_Snapshot_2025.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-14T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit clarifications for MSA (SOC 2 / pen test)

Kim / Marcus — I reviewed the security exhibit and have proposed redlines. High-level notes:  

- Replace blanket "audit rights" language with a scoped approach: "Redwood will provide reasonable access to Redwood-managed systems and documentation necessary to verify security controls; access to customer-controlled storage or customer-configured environments will be excluded."
- Add an NCR (non-conformance remediation) SLA: Redwood will provide remediation summaries within 30 days of verification and will present a remediation plan for critical findings within 7 business days.
- Pen test coordination: require an SOW and a single-point technical contact at Redwood (Marcus) and a communications lead (Laura) for legal questions.

I'll attach a redline doc separately (Proposed_PenTest_SOW.docx) and mark the paragraph language we should push for in negotiations. If you want, I can send the redline directly to Starlight's contracts alias with the hosted language and rationale.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

Attachment: Proposed_PenTest_SOW.docx

From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@starlighthealth.com>

Cc: contracts@starlighthealth.com, procurement@starlighthealth.com, dpo@starlighthealth.com
Date: 2026-08-16T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit clarifications for MSA (SOC 2 / pen test)

Kim, Laura —

Thanks for the quick answers and the SOC snapshot. A few follow-ups from our DPO and procurement:  

- DPO asks for a brief paragraph confirming that any data accessed during support or evidence requests will be treated under the same controls as production data (encryption at rest/in-transit, role-based access, audit logging).
- Procurement needs the pen test SOW with a proposed 2-week window and a list of excluded assets; they also want confirmation that Redwood will provide a remediation summary within 30 days of the test close.

We can accept scoped "audit rights" language if your redline is explicit about Redwood-managed scope + excluded systems. Please send the redline and the pen test SOW to contracts@starlighthealth.com and copy procurement. If October is proposed, can you provide specific date ranges (week-of Oct 12 or Oct 19)?

Best,
Sarah

Hi all — following up with the technical details and concrete proposals so contracts/procurement can lock dates:  

1) Pen test scope proposal (attached: Proposed_PenTest_SOW.docx):
- In-scope: Redwood inference control plane, API endpoints, authentication flow, service-side config management.
- Out-of-scope: Customer-managed storage buckets, customer tenant data stores, third-party integrations that are not operated by Redwood.
- Test window options: week of Oct 12 (Oct 12–16) or week of Oct 19 (Oct 19–23). We recommend Oct 12 if you need earlier resolution.

2) Evidence & remediation cadence:
- SOC-packaged evidence (policies, diagrams, control narratives): delivery within 10 business days after request (we confirm this).
- Forensics/log exports or targeted artifact retrieval: up to 15 business days unless urgent (we will triage).
- Post-pen-test remediation summary: Redwood will provide a remediation summary within 30 calendar days of test completion and a prioritized fix plan for any critical or high findings within 7 business days.

3) Data handling confirmation for DPO:
- Any Redwood access to customer data for evidence or support will follow existing production controls: AES-256 at rest, TLS1.2+ in transit, strict RBAC, and audit logging. Service accounts used for evidence retrieval are limited to least privilege and logged.

4) Logistics:
- Technical POC: Marcus Lin (marcus_lin@redwood.com)
- Legal/comms POC: Laura Bennett (laura_bennett@redwood.com)
- Proposed deliverables: redlined security exhibit PDF, final SOW, SOC2 snapshot (attached).

Action items for Starlight: please confirm preferred test week (Oct 12 or Oct 19) and whether your procurement accepts the remediation timeline. Once we have a week, we'll circulate the SOW and an internal schedule for the test run book.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Security Engineering | Redwood Inference
